{
  "subproblems": [
    "Validate that s1 and s2 are pandas Series and prepare their values for comparison and plotting.",
    "Compute the unique intersection of values shared by s1 and s2 and count them.",
    "Construct a combined DataFrame with values and series labels for a two-category swarm plot.",
    "Create the swarm plot using seaborn and matplotlib.",
    "Highlight each intersecting value with a red dashed horizontal line across the plot.",
    "Return the Axes object and the intersection count."
  ],
  "high_level_plan": [
    "Determine the unique shared values between s1 and s2.",
    "Build plotting data that identifies the source Series for every observation.",
    "Initialize a matplotlib Axes and draw the seaborn swarm plot.",
    "For every shared value, add a red dashed horizontal reference line.",
    "Return the configured Axes and the number of unique shared values."
  ]
}
